definition: Enlarged kidney with replacement of renal parenchyma by low-attenuation collections in a ?hydronephrotic? pattern without dilatation of the renal pelvis and infundibula; resembles the pads and fur on a bear's paw. Suggests xanthogranulomatous pyelonephritis.

label: beaten brass sign
synonyms: beaten brass pattern|beaten silver pattern|beaten silver sign
definition: Numerous impressions in the skull create the impression of a beaten brass pot on a lateral radiograph. Suggests premature closure of sutures and elevated intracranial pressure.

label: bell-shaped ureter sign
definition: Segment of ureter is dilated and shaped like a bell with convex margin inferiorly. Suggests antegrade intussusception due to polypoid tumor.

Intraluminal filling defect with ureter dilated both above and below the level of obstruction. Intraluminal filling defect creates a space distal to the obstruction, resembling a chalice, where a catheter can coil. Suggests a chronic process; typically, ureteral transitional cell carcinoma.

label: big rib sign
definition: Ribs further from the radiograph appear relatively enlarged on a lateral chest image; aids in the localization of basal pulmonary pathology that sillhouettes the adjacent hemidiaphragm but is not visible on a frontal radiograph.

label: myositis
definition: Inflammation of skeletal muscle (muscle, skeletal). Infectious, autoimmune, and paraneoplastic processes represent some of the more common conditions that may be associated with myositis. (From Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed., pp 1402-13) [MeSH]

label: bird's beak sign of colon
synonyms: bird's beak sign, bird beak sign, beak sign
definition: Contrast flow stops and forms sharp beak shape on barium enema; rectum is also distended. Suggests sigmoid volvulus. May form two opposing beaks if contrast passes stenosis.

label: bird's beak sign of esophagus
synonyms: bird's beak sign, bird beak sign, beak sign, rat tail sign
definition: Tapering of the inferior esophagus in achalasia.

label: bite sign
definition: Erosion of bone, often the head of the femur, resembles the shape of an animal bite. Suggests avascular necrosis.

label: black pleura sign
definition: Pleura appears as a lucent line between ribs and dense lungs on a radiograph, suggesting alveolar calcification due to microlithiasis or hyperparathyroidism.

label: bladder ear sign
definition: Lateral projections, usually bilateral, from the bladder seen in infants. Suggests transitory extraperitoneal hernia.

label: bladder sign
definition: Distended bladder, but not enlarged uterine or ovarian mass, obliterates the clear zone anterior and lateal to the pelvic inlet.

label: blade-of-grass sign
definition: A wedge- or V-shaped radiolucent area typically located in the diaphysis of a long bone. Associated with Paget disease.

label: blister of bone
definition: Protrusion of bone cortex with internal septae; outer wall is often compromised. Suggests aneurysmal bone cyst.

label: blister-of-the-cervix sign
definition: Sonolucent cystic shape seen on a cervical ultrasound following conization of the cervix.

label: block vertebra
definition: Congenital vertebral fusion.

label: neuritis
definition: A general term indicating inflammation of a peripheral or cranial nerve. Clinical manifestation may include pain; paresthesias; paresis; or hypesthesia. [MeSH]

label: bone bruise sign
definition: Focal area of hyperintensity in the marrow of the lateral femoral condyle. Suggests anterior cruciate ligament tear and impaction of lateral femoral condyle on lateral tibial plateau.

label: bone-in-bone sign
definition: Small, dense vertebral body shape seen inside actual vertebral body. Caused by sclerotic superior and inferior vertebral midbody, indicating osteopetrosis.

label: bone-scan double density sign
definition: Pattern of uptake that may be seen on bone scans in patients with osteoid osteomas.

label: boot-shaped heart sign
definition: An appearance of the heart on the frontal chest radiograph of a child with decreased pulmonary vasculature, in which the left cardiac border resembles the outline of a wooden boot. The upturned cardiac apex is ascribed to right ventricular hypertrophy. Associated with tetralogy of Fallot.

label: border sign
definition: Sign to distinguish colonic polyp from diverticulum. In longitudinal view, polyp has well-defined inner but indistinct outer border, whereas diverticulum has well-defined outer border but indistinct inner border.

label: boutonniere deformity
definition: Hyperflexion of the proximal interphalangeal joint with hyperextension of the distal interphalangeal joint. Suggests rheumatoid arthritis.

label: bow tie sign
definition: Normal continuity between anterior and posterior horns of the meniscus is present in three or more adjacent MR images; indicates a discoid meniscus.

label: box-like heart
definition: Massive cardiomegaly, primarily right atrial enlargement; associated with Ebstein's anomaly

label: bridging vascular sign
definition: Ultrasound flow signals or MR curvilinear tortuous signal voids found between uterus and extrauterine mass. Represents vessels arising from uterine arteries and suggests an exophytic uterine leiomyoma over other juxtauterine masses.

label: brim sign
definition: Thickened ileopectinal line on frontal radiograph. Suggests Paget disease.

label: orbital pseudotumor
definition: A chronic neoplasm-like inflammatory reaction, usually affecting the orbital tissues of both eyes, also known as orbital myositis. [MeSH]

label: brownian movement sign
definition: Small echoic shapes that appear linear on a real-time ultrasound of the stomach or intestines. Structure is part of the gastrointestinal tract; sign is produced by air bubbles and alimentary particles which move via peristalsis.

label: bulging fissure sign
definition: Lung fissure below an enlarged, consolidated lobe bulges downward on a frontal radiograph. Typically suggests Klebsiella pneumonia, but may also result from any pneumonia, tuberculosis, mass lesion, or abscess.

label: bulging tumor sign
definition: Smooth tumor bulges into the sphenoid sinus with hyperostosis of the sphenoid bone wings on a frontal radiograph. Suggests parasellar meningioma.

label: bull's-eye falciform ligament sign
definition: Lucent region within the falciform ligament on a transverse ultrasound, which normally appears very echodense. Suggests portal hypertension; umbilical vein is partly recanalized.

label: bull's-eye sign of GI tract
definition: Relatively lucent ring-shaped lesion in the gastrointestinal tract produces the appearance of a bull's-eye. Typically suggests metastatic melanoma.

label: bullet and bodkin sign
definition: Sharp transition between dilated ureter proximally and narrow ureter distally resembles a bullet balancing on a bodkin (a long, slender tool). Caused by encasement of ureter; suggests extension from adjacent tumor, metastases, lymphoma, or retroperitoneal fibrosis.

label: bullet-shaped vertebra sign
definition: Anterior margin of vertebra is rounded or bullet-shaped on a lateral radiograph. Suggests dwarfism such as achondroplasia.

label: button sequestrum sign
definition: Radiopaque density within radiolucent lesion in bone on a radiograph. Typically suggests eosinophilic granuloma, but may be caused by osteomyelitis and other diseases.

label: calyceal crescent sign
definition: Crescent-shaped opacity seen on early intravenous pyelogram x-rays that fades over time. Caused by concentration of contrast in collecting ducts and ducts of Bellini diverted by dilated calyces. Suggests hydronephrosis.

label: cancellous ulcer osteoma
definition: Enlarged bone medullary space and thinned cortex beneath an ulcer with osteoporosis distal to the ulcer. Suggests tropical ulcer.

label: candy cane sign
definition: Venous pathway from the lower body to the heart resembles a candy cane on an angiogram. Suggests infrahepatic interruption of the inferior vena cava with azygos continuation; azygous vein is dilated and arches through mediastinum to right atrium.

label: cardiac blur sign
definition: All or part of left heart border is obscurred on a frontal radiograph. Typically suggests postinfarction myocardial scar of anterior wall of left ventricle. May also suggest pleuropericardial scarring, cardiophrenic angle fat pad, or arrythmia.

label: cardiac double density sign
definition: Sign of left atrial enlargement when right side of the left atrium pushes into the adjacent lung.

label: Carman meniscus sign
definition: Semicircular (meniscoid) configuration of gastric ulcer seen in profile with compression, convex toward the lumen. Suggests malignancy.

label: carotid string sign
definition: Thin string-like channel of contrast material in internal carotid artery. May suggest internal carotid arterial dissection, radiation-associated carotid artery disease, atherosclerosis, or thrombosis.

label: carpal sign
definition: Angle between two lines, one tangent to the scaphoid and lunate and the other tangent to the triquetrum and lunate, is less than 117ø, rather than the usual 130ø. Suggests gonadal dysgenesis.

label: Catlin sign
definition: Two lucencies seen just lateral to the sagittal suture on a frontal radiograph. Suggests enlarged parietal foramina, a hereditary defect.

label: celery stalk metaphysis
synonyms: celery stalk sign|celery stick metaphysis|celery stick sign
definition: Irregularity of metaphysis and adjacent diaphysis with longitudinal stripes, resembling a stalk of celery on a radiograph of an infant. Typically suggests rubella of the mother during pregnancy, but may also result from cytomegalic inclusion disease.

label: celery stalk sign
definition: Low-intensity collagen fibers in the longitudinal plane of the anterior cruciate ligament separated by high intensity mucoid matrix. Associated with mucoid degeneration of the ACL.

label: central lucency sign
definition: Apparent kidney mass with central lucency that displaces adjacent infundibula and interlobar arteries seen on intravenous pyleography and angiography. Suggests pseudotumor due to lobar dysmorphism.

label: cervicothoracic sign
definition: A mediastinal mass resides in the anterior portion if its superior border disappears at the level of the clavicle; posterior if clearly visible above the clavicle; and middle if visible part way above the clavicle.

label: chalice sign
synonyms: Bergman coiled catheter sign|Bergman sign|coiled catheter sign|goblet sign|wine glass sign|wine goblet sign
definition: Dilatation of ureter distal to neoplasm.

label: chest abdomen sign
definition: Lung pathology, such as pneumonia, fibrosis, atelectasis, or bronchial wall thickening, is visible with distended loops of bowel on a frontal radiograph. Suggests familial dysautonomia.

label: claw foot
definition: A deformity of the toes in which the toe joint nearest the foot is bent upward and the other toe joints are bent downward. The toe looks like a claw.

label: claw hand
definition: A condition that causes curved or bent fingers; the hand appears like an animal claw. May be due to congenital disorder or nerve damage.

label: clear space sign
definition: Roughly triangular lucency on a frontal chest radiograph bounded by aortic arch and descending aorta medially, pulmonary artery inferiorly, and vessels supplying left upper lobe laterally. Convex outward contour of medial border suggests enlarged left mediastinal lymph nodes due to neoplasia or granulomatous disease.

label: clover-leaf skull
definition: Intrauterine premature fusion (craniosynostosis) of all sutures except squamosal.

label: cluster-of-grapes sign of kidney
synonyms: cluster of grapes sign of kidney|septation sign
definition: Nonfunctional kidney with opacification of walls of many small, lucent cysts, resembling a cluster of grapes on intravenous urography of a neonate. Suggests polycystic kidney disease.

label: cluster-of-grapes sign of lung
synonyms: cluster of grapes sign of lung
definition: Multiple adjacent opacities with wavy borders in the lung resemble a cluster of grapes on a radiograph. Suggests mucoid impaction, due to asthma, bronchitis, or mucoviscidosis.

label: cluster-of-grapes sign of uterus
synonyms: cluster of grapes sign of uterus
definition: Appearance of multiple thin-walled cysts within uterus. Suggest molar pregnancy.

label: cobra head sign
synonyms: cobra head ureter|snake head ureter|spring onion sign
definition: Dilated distal ureter surrounded by relatively lucent halo, resembling the head of a snake. Indicates intravesicular ureterocele. Dilatation results from obstruction of urine flow, and lucent halo is produced by double-sided ureteral mucosal projection into bladder.

label: cockade image
definition: Lytic lesion within a central rosette-shaped opacity, resembling a cockade, in seen on a lateral radiograph of the calcaneus. Suggests intraosseous lipoma.

label: cocktail sausage sign
definition: Swelling in the soft tissue of one toe, often with periosteal reaction, produces the appearance of a cocktail sausage. Suggests rheumatoid variants.

label: Codman triangle
definition: A triangular area of new, subperiosteal bone that is created when a lesion, often a tumor, raises the periosteum away from the bone.

label: coiled tube sign
definition: The main causes for this sign are osteosarcoma, Ewing's sarcoma, and a subperiosteal abscess.

label: coin lesion
definition: A mass in the lung smaller than 3 cm in diameter. It can be an incidental finding found in up to 0.2% of chest X-rays and around 1% of CT scans

label: collapsing cord sign
definition: Fluid migrates to the lower end of a dilated spinal cord on an air myelogram, with the head up, compared to a Pantopaque myelogram, with the head down. Suggests hydromyelia over intramedullary neoplasm.

label: collar sign
definition: Constriction of the liver where it transverses a diaphragmatic defect. Sign of diaphragmatic rupture.

label: collateral vein sign
definition: Collateral veins seen draining a kidney with a renal cell carcinoma. Typically suggests compromise of the renal vein.

label: colon cutoff sign
definition: Colonic gas abruptly stops near the splenic flexure. Suggests acute pancreatitis; inflammatory exudate spreads to phrenicocolic ligament, causing spasms that narrow the lumen at the flexure, where the colon becomes retroperitoneal.

label: transition zone of prostate
definition: PI-RADS: Tissue around the urethra that is separated from the peripheral zone by the “surgical capsule” delineated as a low signal line on T2 weighted MRI. It is the site of most BPH.

label: colon sign
definition: Colon, with visible gas and feces, occupies the renal fossa when kidney is not seen on intravenous pyelography. Suggests renal absence over renal disease.

label: comb sign
definition: Thick, tortuous, and parallel vessels are visible on the mesenteric side of intestine, resembling teeth of a comb. Often present with fibrofatty proliferation. Typically Indicates active Crohn's disease.

label: comet sign
definition: Hyperattenuating mass with tail of soft tissue attenuation resembles a comet. Suggests phlebolith; tail is noncalcified portion of vein. Differentiates phlebolith from ureteral calculus.

label: concentric ring sign
definition: Hypointense outer ring, hyperintense inner ring, and central mass of normal or variable intensity seen on kidney MR image. Outer and inner rings represent pseudocapsule and hemoglobin degradation, respectively. Suggests hematoma.

label: continuous diaphragm sign
definition: Medial portion of diaphragm is seen in continuity with lateral portions rather than being obscured by water density of heart on a frontal radiograph. Suggests pneumomediastinum.

label: contracting cord sign
definition: Dilated spinal cord decreases in diameter over months on subsequent myelograms. Suggests multiple sclerosis.

label: contrast bubble sign
definition: Bubble with visible contrast border forms outside lumen of gastrointestinal tract; localizes a perforation.

label: converging line sign
definition: Three curved, dense lines converge at a central dense point on an abdominal radiograph. Suggests sigmoid volvulus; middle line is two apposed walls of twisted bowel loop, and outer two lines are apposed walls of twisted bowel loop with normal cecum or descending colon.

label: cookie cutter lesion
definition: Radiographic appearance of a metastasis to bony cortex, in which it appears as if a bite has been taken from the bone.

label: cord sign
definition: A homogeneous, hyperattenuating, cordlike appearance on a unenhanced transverse brain CT, which appears as a result of increased attenuation in either the dural sinuses or a vein filled with thrombus.

label: corduroy cloth vertebra
definition: Appearance of thickened trabeculations seen in intraosseous hemangiomas of the spine.

label: corkscrew bowel sign
definition: Duodenum and proximal jejunum spiral around each other on CT or upper GI series. Suggests malrotation and midgut volvulus.

label: corkscrew collaterals
definition: Collateral vessels that may be seen in patients with Buerger disease.
Distal ureter is thin and coiled. Suggests extrinsic compression.

label: corner sign
definition: Small lateral zone of rarefaction in the cortex proximal to the metaphysis on a radiograph of an infant's long bone produces a visible corner. Suggests infantile scurvy.

label: cortical ring sign of mandible
definition: Dense ring surrounding mandibular neck on a lateral radiograph. Suggests anteromedially dislocated condylar neck fracture.

label: cortical ring sign of wrist
definition: Scaphoid appears foreshortened with a dense ring inside on frontal radiograph. Suggests rotary subluxation of the scaphoid and scapholunate dissociation.

label: costal cartilage sign
definition: Sex can be determined by costal cartilage calcification pattern on a frontal radiograph. In males, upper and lower edges of costal cartilage calcify first (tram track sign); in females, either one large or two small lines of calcification project into the cartilage from the center of the rib (wagging tongue sign).

label: cotton wool sign
definition: Multiple small opacities, shaped like tufts of wool, are seen on a lateral radiograph of the cranium, which also has an enlarged marrow space. Suggests Paget disease of the cranium.

label: cracked walnut sign
definition: Enlarged ventricles, sulci, and fissures make the brain resemble a walnut on a CT scan. Suggests degenerative disease in young patients, but may be normal in the elderly.

label: crazy-paving sign
definition: Ground-glass lung opacity with network (reticular) pattern, seen in transverse lung CT images, resembling pavement of broken material. Classically associated with pulmonary alveolar proteinosis.

label: crescent sign
definition: Gastric ulcer with concavity toward lumen and convexity away from lumen. Suggests benign gastric ulcer; produced by mucosa hanging over orifice of ulcer.

label: kidney crescent sign
synonyms: crescent sign kidney|crescent sign of kidney
definition: Thin, curvilinear collections of contrast, arranged parallel to kidney surface, are seen adjacent to dilated, nonopacified calyces on an intravenous pyelogram. Suggests chronic obstructive uropathy with intact excretory function.

Thin, curvilinear lucent line parallel to the cortical margin of the femoral head. Interruption of the blood supply to the femoral head leads to ischemic necrosis of the marrow and bone that it supplies.

label: Cromlech sign
definition: Extraluminal opacity surrounded by several smaller opacities in the gall bladder, resembling stone monuments. Suggests extraluminal adenomyomatosis.

label: crossover sign
definition: Lateral projection of anterior acetabular rim relative to same point of posterior rim in the superolateral aspect of the acetabulum. Seen with pincer-type femoroacetabular impingement.

label: crowded carpal sign
definition: Distal carpal row overlaps proximal carpal row in frontal radiograph. Indicates volar perilunar dislocation.

label: CT angiogram sign
definition: Prominent pulmonary vessels seen traversing a hypoattenuating consolidation of lung parenchyma on contrast-enhanced CT. Most commonly suggests bronchoalveolar cell carcinoma; may also be lymphoma or pneumonia.

label: CT arrowhead sign
definition: Arrowhead shape in the cecum near the appendiceal orifice on transverse CT scans following oral or rectal contrast administration. Suggests appendicitis; contrast funnels into thickened cecal wall near orifice.
A pulmonary mass or nodule is surrounded by a wide halo of ground-glass attenuation. Indicates a hemorrhagic nodule, usually due to angioinvasive aspergillosis.

label: Cupid bow vertebra
definition: Inferior endplates of 4th and 5th lumbar vertebrae are curved, forming the shape of a bow with two curved extremities pointed superiorly on a frontal radiograph. Normal variant of spine.

label: cupola sign
definition: An arcuate lucency overlying the lower thoracic spine and inferior to the heart on supine radiography suggesting air in the median subphrenic space.

label: curlicue ureter sign
definition: Ureter makes a loop on an intravenous urogram or retrograde urogram, suggesting ureteral hernia. If loop is vertical, hernia is in the scrotal, inguinal, or preinguinal region; if horizontal, hernia is in the sciatic foramen.

label: curvature sign
definition: Large fluid collection with a curved anterior margin on transverse ultrasound below the liver. If anteriorly convex, suggests ascites. If anteriorly concave, suggests ovarian cyst.

label: cyclops lesion
definition: May occur status post anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction.

label: dagger sign
definition: Thin, dense vertical line running through spinous processes on a frontal radiograph. Suggests ankylosing spondylitis.

label: deep lateral femoral notch sign
definition: The increased depth of the lateral femoral sulcus in patients with an ACL tear is due to impacted fracture, similar to a Hill-Sachs lesion of the humerus.

label: deep sulcus sign
definition: Abnormally deep, angular, and lucent lateral costophrenic angle on supine chest radiograph. Suggests pneumothorax.

label: deflected calyx sign
definition: Calyx is displaced by adjacent pseudotumor on an intravenous urogram or retrograde urogram. Suggests renal tuberculosis; narrowing of the infundibulum causes dilation and filling of obstructed minor calyx, which then displaces the adjacent calyx.

label: dense metaphyseal band sign
definition: Increased metaphyseal opacity, especially in growing bones of wrist and knee. Most often normal, but may also indicate lead poisoning.

label: dense vessel sign
definition: Sign of cerebrovascular accident. Represents thrombus in middle cerebral artery.

label: dependent viscera sign
definition: Positioning of bowel and solid abdominal organs against the posterior ribs, with obliteration of the costophrenic recess; suggests diaphragmatic rupture.

label: Deuel halo sign
definition: Abnormally thick soft-tissue density between cranial vault and subcutaneous fat of scalp on a radiograph. Indicates fetal demise.

label: deviated descending thoracic aorta sign
definition: Lateral deviation of the descending thoracic aorta, most pronounced at the level of the left atrium, on a frontal radiograph. Suggests left atrial enlargement.

label: diastolic washout sign
definition: Artery with pseudoaneurysm becomes more lucent during on an angiogram. Blood flows from pseudoaneurysm into arterial lumen and washes out contrast.

label: dilated transverse colon sign
definition: Dilated transverse colon with empty cecum and ascending colon on a frontal radiograph. Suggests appendicitis, often with perforated appendix.

label: dimple sign
definition: Retraction of normal renal cortex next to an avascular mass on an angiogram. Most commonly suggests malignancy.

label: disappearing basal ganglia sign
definition: Loss of normal basal ganglia morphology seen on transverse CT images. Suggests infarction, especially of the middle cerebral artery.

label: disappearing ellipse sign
definition: Two lucent lines form a thin ellipse on a radiograph of the skull that disappears on an oblique projection. Suggests linear skull fracture; ellipse results from x-ray beam hitting inner and outter tables at slightly different angles.
An appearance of fused kidneys.

label: discarded string sign
definition: Gas, visible radiographically as thin, linear or wavy lucencies, in the fetal umbilical veins. Indicates fetal death.

label: disk kidney
synonyms: cake kidney|disc kidney|doughnut kidney|lump kidney|pancake kidney|pelvic lump kidney
definition: One large, central renal mass is seen that does not resemble a kidney; mass is not elevated, and typically has two ureters with normal insertion. Indicates complete fusion of kidneys.

label: displaced crus sign
definition: Diaphragmatic crus is laterally displaced and fluid is visible between crus and vertebral column on a CT scan. Suggests intrapleural fluid over ascites.

label: displaced retroperitoneal fat sign
definition: Retroperitoneal fat echo is displaced on a sagittal ultrasound, revealing the location of a posterior right upper quadrant mass. If displaced posteriorly and inferiorly, mass is intraperitoneal. If displaced anteriorly, mass is retroperitoneal and typically renal or adrenal.

label: displaced spinolaminar line sign
definition: Spinolaminar line does not form a smooth arc on a lateral radiograph of the cervical spinal cord. Suggests trauma at the level where the line is disrupted. Displacement of line at C2 is sometimes normal.

label: disruptive diaphragmatic echo sign
definition: Echoic line representing right hemidiaphragm is not continuous on an ultrasound. May suggest tumor invasion, metastases, or rupture following infection or trauma.

label: distended common bile duct
definition: Tubular impression on duodenal bulb. May be caused by distended common bile duct, enlarged lymph nodes, or other mass.

label: divergent spinous processes sign
definition: Lines drawn through spinous processes of cervical vertebrae do not converge posterior to the spine on a lateral radiograph following flexion injury. Suggests ligamentous damage.

label: dog leg sign
definition: Popliteal artery lumen abruptly bends as it traverses the popliteal fossa on an arteriogram, sometimes also dilating. Most commonly indicates popliteal aneurysm, but may also be atherosclerotic popliteal artery, Baker cyst, or popliteal arterial entrapment syndrome.

label: dog's ear sign
definition: Bilateral density shaped like dog's ears on a supine radiograph. Suggests free blood in the dependent portions of the peritoneal cavity.

label: dot and dash pattern
definition: Sacral insufficiency fracture.

label: double bleb sign
definition: Appearance of amnion and yolk sac at 5-6 weeks. Embryo lies between amnion and yolk sac

label: double bronchial wall sign
definition: Air in the mediastinum and left main bronchus, which allows visualization of both sides of the bronchial wall.

label: double bubble sign
definition: Two lucent structures visible in the upper abdomen of an infant, representing air-filled stomach and duodenum, with no air distally. Suggests internal obstruction (duodenal atresia), external compression, or volvulus.

label: double cava sign
definition: A structure of similar size and attenuation resembles a second inferior vena cava adjacent to the true structure on a CT scan. Suggests retroperitoneal adenopathy.

label: double condom sign
definition: Oval or round density surrounded by thin lucent ring seen in the gastrointestinal tract on a radiograph. Suggests narcotic smuggling; ring is produced by air trapped between condoms containing drugs.

label: double contour sign
definition: Two right borders of the heart are visible on a frontal radiograph. Suggests enlargement of the left atrium, which may extend beyond the right atrium or produce increased density within.

label: double decidual sac sign
definition: Sign of early normal intrauterine gestation.

label: double duct sign
definition: Simultaneously dilated pancreatic duct and common bile duct; associated with pancreatic head mass.

label: double outline sign
definition: Two articular mass shadows are seen at one level on a lateral radiograph. Suggests articular mass fracture; one articular mass is partially collapsed.

label: otitis
definition: Inflammation of the ear, which may be marked by pain, fever, abnormalities of hearing, hearing loss, tinnitus, and vertigo. Inflammation of the external ear is otitis externa; of the middle ear, otitis media; of the inner ear, labyrinthitis. (From Dorland, 27th ed) [MeSH]

label: double posterior cruciate ligament sign
definition: Small low intensity band parallel and inferior to posterior cruciate ligament resembles second PCL in sagittal MR images. Indicates longitudinal bucket-handle tear of the meniscus.

label: double spinous process sign
definition: Two vertically oriented shadows for one spinous process of a frontal radiograph. Suggests clay shoveler's fracture with inferior displacement of the avulsed fragment.

label: double track sign
definition: Appearance of hypertrophic pyloric stenosis that may be seen on upper GI series.

label: double-line sign
definition: Hyperintense line and parallel hypointense rim seen on T2-weighted MR image of long bone metaphysis or epiphysis. Suggests osteonecrosis; hyper- and hypointense line represent granulation tissue and sclerotic bone, respectively.

label: doughnut sign
definition: Circular lucency surrounded by thick sclerotic ring on a radiograph of the skull; may contain central density as well. Lesion is often discovered incidentally and asymptomatic.

label: draped aorta sign
definition: Sign of contained rupture of an abdominal aoric aneurysm.

label: dripping candle wax sign
synonyms: dripping candle sign|dripping candlewax sign|dripping wax sign|flowing candle wax sign
definition: Irregular thickening of bone that resembles wax dripping down a candle, usually due to cortical hyperostosis. Most common in long bones of limbs. Suggests melorheostosis.

label: dromedary hump
definition: Hump-like lateral contour of left kidney due to molding by adjacent organs; a normal variant. Consists of normal kidney tissue.

label: drooping lily sign
definition: Caudal and lateral displacement of opacified lower pole moiety of a duplex kidney by obstructed (unopacified) upper pole moeity, resembling a drooping flower. Upper pole moiety typically obstructed by ectopic ureterocele.

label: drooping shoulder sign
definition: Humerus is displaced inferiorly from the acromioclavicular joint and glenoid on a radiograph. Indicates inferior subluxation of the shoulder, and often found with surgical neck fracture.

label: otitis media
definition: Inflammation of the middle ear. [MeSH]

label: drowned hilus sign
definition: Fluid collection surrounds the vessels of the splenic hilum on an intercostal ultrasound following splenic trauma. Suggests hemoperitoneum.

label: duodenal wind sock sign
definition: Duodenum contains a barium-filled sac surrounded by thin radiolucent line distally on upper GI series. Indicates intraluminal duodenal diverticulum in which membrane has been elongated by peristalsis.

label: dural tail sign
definition: A tail of hyperenhanced dura mater is seen extending from a mass on MR images, suggesting a meningioma.

label: early filling vein sign
definition: Vein or group of veins fills in the first three seconds after intracerebral contrast circulation on an arteriogram. Typically suggests malignant neoplasm, but may also suggest benign meningioma, inflammation, trauma, and ischemia.

label: edge sign
definition: Inferior border of liver and lateral border of left lobe are rounded and convex rather than angulated on an ultrasound.

label: egg-on-its-side heart
definition: Marked cardiomegaly with a narrow superior mediastinum; typical of transposition of the great vessels (TGV)

label: ellipse sign
definition: Elliptical collection of barium seen in upper gastrointestinal tract. If parallel to lumen, represents ulceration; if perpendicular, represents deformity without ulceration.

label: empty delta sign
definition: High-attenuating triangle filled with low-attenuating space on contrast-enhanced CT scans in the superior sagittal sinus, indicating thrombosis.

label: empty mediastinum sign
definition: Anterior mediastinum is unusually lucent on a lateral radiograph of an infant. Suggests thymic dysgenesis. Typically due to immunological defect.

label: enlargement of the hilar periportal space
definition: The distance between the anterior wall of the right branch of the portal vein and the posterior edge of the medial segment of the left liver lobe is enlarged. Indicates cirrhosis; space is enlarged and filled with fat.

label: otitis externa
definition: Inflammation of the external auditory canal. (Dorland, 27th ed) [MeSH]

label: epicardial fat pad sign
definition: Increased width of soft-tissue density separating subepicardial fat and anterior mediastinal fat on a lateral radiograph. Suggests pericardial effusion or pericardial thickening.

label: esophageal tube displacement sign
definition: Displacement of nasogastric tube to the right following trauma. Suggests thoracic aortic rupture and mediastinal hematoma.

label: extrapleural air sign
definition: Air between parietal pleura and diaphragm beneath the dome of a hemidiaphragm on a radiograph; does not redistribute with change in position. Suggests pneumomediastinum.

label: extrapleural sign
definition: Peripheral lung lesion has sharp convex inner edge toward lung with tapered superior and inferior edges on a frontal radiograph. Suggests lesion is extrapleural rather than intrapulmonary.

label: eye-of-the-tiger sign
definition: Hyperintense longitudinal stripe in the middle of a hypointense globus pallidus, caused by iron deposition, resembles a tiger's eye on T2-weighted MRI. Usually suggets Hallervorden-Spatz disease, but may be similar in extrapyramidal Parkinsonian disorder.

label: fabella sign
definition: Posterior displacement of the fabella on a lateral radiograph of the knee. Suggests synovial effusion or intrasynovial mass.

label: faceless kidney
definition: Lack of visible central fat or collecting system on CT scan of kidney. May indicate duplex kidney, in which cross section is between two collecting systems and is filled with parenchyma, but refers to any inflammatory or infiltrative process that destroys usual pattern.

label: falciform ligament sign
definition: Falciform ligament is outlined by air on a supine radiograph, indicating pneumoperitoneum.

label: fallen fragment sign
definition: Fracture through a lucent cyst with bony fragment that has fallen through the cyst. Suggests unicameral bone cyst.

label: falx sign
definition: Long, thin line of high attenuation running sagittally through the middle of the brain on a nonenhanced CT scan, representing the falx cerebri. Originally ascribed to subarachnoid bleeding, but now recognized as normal.

label: fat C2 sign
definition: Distance between anterior and posterior margins is larger for C2 than C3 on lateral radiograph. Suggests oblique fracture through C2 body with subsequent displacement of anterior or posterior margin.

label: fat halo sign
definition: Fat-attenuation ring between high-attenuation Inner (mucosal) and outer (muscularis, serosa) rings on abdominal CT scans. Associated with Crohn disease and ulcerative colitis.

label: fat pad sign
definition: Raised anterior lucency (normally parallel) and/or presence of posterior lucency (normally invisible), representing extrasynovial fat pads, are present on distal humerus on lateral radiograph of flexed elbow.

label: fat ring sign
definition: Preservation of the perivascular fat around the mesenteric vessels that may be seen with mesenteric panniculitis.

label: fat sign
definition: Radiolucent halo surrounding gallbladder. Represents fat deposits, indicating acalculous gallbladder disease.

label: FBI sign
definition: Separation of fatty bone marrow and blood seen on a radiograph, indicating lipohemarthrosis. Typically results from intraarticular joint fracture.

label: feeding vessel sign
definition: A distinct vessel leading directly into the center of a lung nodule. Highly suggestive of septic embolism.

label: fickle finger sign
definition: Hypoglossal canal is Pantopaque-filled and resembles a finger projecting inferiorly on a lateral myelogram; may be mistaken for normal internal acoustic meatus even if meatus is blocked by acoustic neuroma. Distinguished by projection on horizontal base view; hypoglossal canal finger projects caudad to petrous bone, whereas internal acoustic meatus fingers projects into petrous bone.

label: figure 3 sign
definition: Figure 3 shape of right border of aorta on frontal chest radiograph. Suggests dilated aorta proximal and distal to focal narrowing, such as coaractation of the aorta.

label: figure E sign
definition: Curved E-shaped indentation on the right esophageal wall on an upper GI series. Produced by dilation of the aorta both proximal and distal to a local narrowing, suggesting coaractation of the aorta.

label: figure 8 sign of brain
synonyms: figure eight sign of brain|figure-of-eight sign of brain
definition: Shallow sylvian fissures resulting in a figure-eight appearance of the axial CT images of brain. Characteristic of pachygyria and lissencephaly.
Tubular opacities within bronchi, seen in mucoid impaction (mucous plugging).

label: fish vertebra
definition: Biconcave vertebral bodies seen on a radiograph, resembling the spine of a fish. Suggests osteopenia.

label: fishhook ureter
synonyms: J-shaped ureter|fish hook sign|fish hook ureter|fishhooking|hockey stick ureter
definition: Terminal ureter curves upward, resembling a fishhook. Suggests prostatic hypertrophy, which elevates trigone.

label: fissure sign
definition: Reduced radionuclide uptake seen along major or minor fissure on lung scintigraph. Represents increased area of hypoperfusion, often due to pleural effusion.

label: flame shaped breast tissue
definition: Fibroglandular tissue in the retro-areolar area of the breast, which radiates from the nipple into the deeper adipose tissue; seen in gynecomastia.

label: flank stripe sign
definition: Increased distance of soft-tissue density (flank stripe) between extraperitoneal fat and lumen of colon on a lateral radiograph. Suggests inflammation, edema, or hemmorhage.

label: flared mandible sign
definition: Fractures of the condylar necks or rami and mandibular symphisis cause retraction and internal rotation of the mandibular bodies, producing a flared appearance on a frontal radiograph. Suggests possibility of airway occlusion due to ineffective genioglossus muscles.

label: flat tire sign
definition: Sign of a ruptured globe.

label: flat waist sign
definition: Left heart border is flat rather than concave on a frontal radiograph. Suggests left lower lobe collapse, causing right anterior oblique rotation.

label: Fleischner line
definition: Long linear shadow (fibrotic scar) from invagination of pleura at the base of the collapse resulting in pseudofissure; seen in pulmonary infarction.

label: Fleischner sign of chest
definition: Unilaterally enhanced main pulmonary artery on a frontal radiograph. Suggests ipsilateral pulmonary embolism.

label: Fleischner sign of ileum
definition: Narrowed distal ileum with enlarged, patulous ileocecal valve, resembling an umbrella turned inside-out. Suggests tuberculosis or Crohn disease.

label: floating aorta sign
definition: Aorta is displaced anteriorly and is further from the lumbar spine than normal on a CT scan. Suggests retroperitoneal abnormality.

label: floating myodil sign
definition: Myodil appears to float on cerebrospinal fluid in the ventricles on a CT scan. Suggests presence of fat in ventricles.

label: floating tooth sign
definition: Thin lucency surrounding mandibular teeth, giving them the appearance of floating. Suggests peridontal destruction, typically due to Langerhans cell histiocytosis; may also be seen in neuroblastoma and Burkitt lymphoma.

label: floating viscera sign
definition: Aortic branch vessels, but not the true lumen of the proximal aorta, are opacified with contrast injection, and thus have no apparent source. Indicates dynamically compromised aortic dissection.

label: floppy thumb sign
definition: Radial subluxation or dislocation of the interphalangeal joint of the thumb makes the thumb appear floppy on a radiograph. Suggests dermatomyositis or polymyositis.

label: fluid-fluid level
definition: Both water- and blood-density fluids are seen within bone lesion on CT. Typically indicates aneurysmal bone cyst, but may also be giant cell tumor, telangectatic osteosarcoma, or chondroblastoma.

label: focal hepatic hot spot sign
definition: Focal spot of high tracer uptake on liver scan or high attenuation on CT due to growth of collateral venous pathways. Focal spot in segment IV suggests superior vena cava obstruction.

label: football sign
definition: Massive pneumoperitoneum distends abdomen (football shape) and often outlines the falciform and umbilical ligaments, (sutures of the ball). Most commonly seen in infants, and usually indicates gastrointestinal perforation.

label: four-tendon sign
definition: Four tendinous structures instead of the usual three are seen on the medial ankle in transverse MR images. Represents longitudinally split posterior tibial tendon.

label: fragment-in-notch sign
definition: Hypointense band seen in intercondylar notch on MR image. Represents lateral meniscal fragment from bucket-handle tear.

label: fragmented staghorn calculus
definition: A staghorn calculus that appears fragmented, may be produced by enlargement of the kidney due to pyonephrosis or xanthogranulomatous pyelonephritis.

label: Frostberg inverted-3 sign
synonyms: Frostberg inverted-three sign|Frostberg sign|inverted 3 sign|inverted three sign
definition: Medial wall of 2nd portion of duodenum retracted medially to resemble an inverted 3 on upper GI series; middle point is where pancreatic and bile ducts insert into papilla. Suggests pancreatic carcinoma, acute pancreatitis, or postbulbar ulcer.

label: fuzzy fluid level sign
definition: Air-fluid interface is blurred in stomach but sharp in all other areas.

label: gallbladder inertia sign
definition: Minimal gallbladder contraction following fatty meal, suggesting celiac sprue.

label: gasless abdomen sign
definition: Lack of gas in abdominal cavity on a frontal radiograph. May suggest obstruction, acute pancreatitis, ishchemia and venous occlusion, or may be normal.

label: gastric cannonball sign
definition: Mutliple round, fixed, and noncompressible filling defects in the stomach. Typically suggests hepatic metastases. May also represent submucosal leiomyoma, hepatic cyst impressions, gastric serosal metastases, intramural varicosities, or hematoma.
Thin line of barium in intestine visible in barium-enhanced images, representing narrowed lumen. Often found in terminal ileum, and suggests Crohn disease.

label: ghost vertebrae sign
definition: Adult vertebrae and pelvis contain densities within in the shape of infantile bones, including notches in the anterior surface of the ghost vertebral bodies. Indicates patient received thorotrast in early childhood.

label: gloved finger sign
definition: Thick, tubular opacities extend outward from the hilum, resembling fingers a gloved hand. Indicates mucoid impaction, due to bronchial obstruction, allergic bronchopulmonary aspergillosis, or asthma.
Ureter is dilated distal to a narrowing, producing a goblet shape; best seen on retrograde ureterograph. Indicates filling mass is a transitional cell ureteral carcinoma.

label: Golden S sign
synonyms: Golden sign|S sign|S sign of Golden|reverse S sign of Golden
definition: Medial portion of minor fissure of right lung is convex inferiorly and lateral portion is concave inferiorly on posterioanterior radiograph, indicating upper lobe collapse. Transverse CT also shows convexity in collapsed lobe. Suggests bronchial carcinoma or other central mass.

label: golf ball-on-tee sign
synonyms: ball-and-cup sign|ball-on-a-tee sign|ball-on-tee sign|golf ball-on-a-tee sign
definition: Contrast filling a cavity in a renal papilla (the ball) adjacent to a blunted calyx (the tee); indicates papillary necrosis.

label: Gorham vanishing bone disease
definition: syndrome of spontaneous osteolysis

label: gravitational shift sign
definition: Pulmonary infiltrates shift to the dependent portion of the lung during prolonged decubitus positioning, visible on frontal radiographs taken before and after. Suggests pulmonary edema.

label: ground glass pattern
definition: Ground-glass is a common pattern of abnormality seen on high-resolution chest CT, and is a nonspecific pattern seen in a variety of acute or chronic interstitial and airspace diseases. Common acute conditions include pneumonia, pulmonary hemorrhage, and ARDS.

label: ground-glass sign
definition: Abdominal organs are poorly outlined, and abdominal radiograph has general haziness. Suggests ascites.

label: growing calculus sign
definition: Calculi appears to enlarge after administration of contrast, which fills ectatic tubules where the calculi reside. Suggests medullary sponge kidney.

label: osteitis fibrosa cystica
definition: A fibrous degeneration, cyst formation, and the presence of fibrous nodules in bone, usually due to hyperparathyroidism. [MeSH]

label: gull wing appearance
definition: Appearance of erosions that may occur in patients with erosive osteoarthritis.

label: gull wing sign
definition: Two curved shadows resemble the wings of a flying gull on a lateral radiograph of the hip following trauma. Suggests fracture and dislocation of the posterior acetabular rim, often with dislocation of the femoral head. Wings represent the fractured and unfractured portion of the acetabulum.

label: H vertebra
synonyms: H-shaped vertebra|H-shaped vertebral body|Lincoln Log sign|Lincoln Log vertebra
definition: Central endplates of vertebrae are depressed on a lateral radiograph, but anterior and posterior margins are not, producing an H shape. Typically suggests sickle cell anemia.

label: hair-on-end sign
synonyms: hair-on-end pattern|hair-on-end skull|spiculated periosteal reaction|sunburst periosteal reaction
definition: Thin outward striations in the diploic space and widening of the space itself indicate red marrow hyperplasia. Associated with severe anemia, such as thalassemia major.

label: half moon sign (chest)
definition: The half-moon sign is defined as a shadow seen on the lateral chest radiograph consisting of a smooth, partially demarcated opacity with the rounded portion of the half moon projecting over the aortic lumen at the level of the aortic arch, but the rest of the opacity merging with the aorta. The half-moon sign shown on the lateral chest radiograph is highly suggestive of the saccular aortic arch aneurysm.

label: half moon sign (shoulder)
definition: Half moon-shaped shadow created by overlap between humeral head and glenoid on a frontal radiograph. Absent when shoulder is dislocated posteriorly.

label: halo sign of breast
definition: A complete or partial radiolucent ring surrounding the periphery of a breast mass, frequently seen with cysts and fibroadenomas. Can appear with malignant lesions.

label: halo sign of duodenum
definition: Contrast-filled sac surrounded by lucent halo in duodenum on upper GI series. Suggests intraluminal duodenal diverticulum.

label: halo sign of heart
definition: Radiolucent ring around the border of the heart but not beyond great vessels on a frontal radiograph of a neonate. Suggests pneumopericardium.

label: halo sign of liver
definition: Round density surrounding lucent liver defect on a hepatic angiogram; hepatic artery and portal vein are often displaced. Suggests avascular or hypovascular intrahepatic mass; compressed, hyperemic parenchyma surrounds lesion.

label: halo sign of lung
definition: Ground-glass attenuation surrounding a pulmonary nodule or mass on CT images. Represents hemorrhage and is highly suggestive of Aspergillus.

label: Hampton hump sign
definition: Wedge-shaped consolidation extending from the pleural surface with a convex border toward the hilum on a chest radiograph. Often found near costophrenic angle. Suggests pulmonary infarction.

label: harlequin appearance
definition: Superolateral margins of orbits are elevated on a frontal radiograph, resembling a harlequin mask; frontal bone is flattened. Suggests coronal craniosynostosis.

label: Hawkins sign
definition: Subchondral lucency in the dome of the talus seen on radiograph 6-8 weeks after fracture. Presence indicates blood supply is intact and therefore avascular necrosis is unlikely.

label: headcheese sign
definition: Presence of both ground-glass opacity and mosaic perfusion on high-resolution chest CT. Indicative of mixed infiltrative and obstructive disease, usually associated with bronchiolitis.

label: heel pad sign
definition: Thick calcaneal heel pad visible on a lateral radiograph. Suggests acromegaly.

label: Hellmer sign
definition: Lateral border of liver is displaced medially, and lucency is visible between liver and abdominal wall. Suggests ascites or extraperitoneal fluid.

label: hematocrit effect
definition: A crescent shape with a sharp separation between nonhomogeneous, hypoattenuating region and hyperattenuating region in the dependent portion. Suggests subdural hematoma; denser elements settle in the dependent portion.

label: hepatic angle sign
definition: Inferior margin of liver is obscured on an abdominal radiograph. Suggests ascites, particularly of right lateral margin of liver is clearly seen.

label: herniated mediastinal pleural sac sign
definition: Crescent-shaped lucency crossing the midline into a partially collapsed lung on a frontal radiograph. Suggests pneuomothorax; gas-containing sac extends from mediastinal pleural space to contralateral side, often with mediastinal shift.

label: otosclerosis
definition: The formation of spongy bone in the labyrinth capsule. The ossicles can become fixed and unable to transmit sound vibrations, thereby causing deafness. [MeSH]

label: hide-bound bowel sign
definition: Dilated bowel with tightly packed valvulae conniventes visible on barium study. Represents smooth muscle atrophy and fibrosis, a gastrointestinal complication of scleroderma, which also causes patient's skin to look hidebound.

label: high-attenuating crescent sign
definition: Presence of a crescent-shaped rim of increased attenuation on non-contrast CT images of the aorta. Suggests intramural aortic dissection, and may herald aortic rupture.

label: hiked-up renal pelvis
definition: Distortion of the renal pelvis because of stricturing and retraction has been described as a hiked-up or purse-string appearance. T

label: Hill-Sachs deformity sign
definition: Indentation or groove on posterolateral aspect of humeral head, suggesting impaction of humeral head on posterior lip of glenoid labrum due to anterior shoulder dislocation.

label: hilum convergence sign
definition: In setting of enlarged pulmonary hilum, convergence of pulmonary artery branches toward lateral margin of the mass suggests enlargement of the pulmonary artery; converge toward heart suggests mediastinal mass.

label: hilum overlay sign
definition: Main pulmonary artery is observed within a hilar mass instead of near border of cardiac shadow on a frontal radiograph. Suggests anterior mediastinal mass rather than displacement of hilum due to cardiomegaly.

label: hitchhiker thumb
definition: Hypoplasia of the first metacarpal; characteristic of diastrophic dysplasia (diastrophic dwarfism). Alternate definition: An autosomal recessive trait more formally known as distal hyperextensibility of the thumb.

label: hole-within-a-hole pattern
definition: Osteolytic lesion with beveled edge gives a three-dimensional appearance of a hole within a hole on a radiograph. Suggests histiocytosis X.

label: holly leaf appearance
definition: Viewed en face, calcified pleural plaques are seen as irregular, heterogeneous densities, the so-called holly leaf. Seen in asbestos-related pleural disease.

label: Honda sign
definition: An H-shaped pattern of increased activity on bone scan, seen in sacral insufficiency fracture.

label: honeycomb lung
definition: The radiological and gross appearance of the lungs resulting from diffuse fibrosis and cystic dilation of bronchioles.

label: hook sign
definition: Retrograde flow stops and colon recoils on a barium enema of a newborn. Suggests type 3 congenital colic atresia; mesentary defect allows free proximal end of distal colic segment to recoil, creating the hook.

label: horseshoe kidney
definition: A congenital disorder affecting about 1 in 400 people in which the patient's kidneys fuse together to form a horseshoe-shape during development in the womb. The fused part is the isthmus of the horseshoe kidney.

label: hot air balloon sign
definition: Massive, rounded, lucenct diverticulum of the sigmoid colon resembles a hot air balloon; attachment to the colon resembles the gondola. Suggests slowly expanding abscess.

label: hot cross bun sign
definition: Degeneration of myelinated fibers running transversely through pons and in pontine raphe form high intensity cruciform shape. May be seen on axial T2-weighted images of the pons in multiple system atrophy.

label: hot nose sign
definition: Increased radionuclide activity in the nasopharyngeal area, resulting from occluded internal carotid artery and increased external carotid artery flow. Suggests brain death.

label: hourglass appearance
definition: MRI appearance that may be seen with concentric cystic adventitial disease of the popliteal artery.

label: hump sign
definition: Hump in an air-fluid interface, often with abnormal gas gubbles or radiolucent shadow below on a radiograph. Suggests ascariasis.

label: hydronephrotic rim
definition: Thin enhanced rim surrounds a large hypoattenuation in the center of the kidney on contrast-enhanced CT; rim is of variable thickness and concave toward renal hilum, and cortical columns are often enhanced. Indicates chronic hydronephrosis.

label: hyperattenuating crescent sign
definition: Crescent-shape found along posterior wall of abdominal aorta on CT scan of higher attenuation than luminal blood. Indicates impending rupture of abdominal aortic aneurysm as blood penetrates thrombus or arterial wall.

label: pancreatitis
definition: inflammation of the pancreas. Pancreatitis is classified as acute unless there are computed tomographic or endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatographic findings of chronic pancreatitis (International Symposium on Acute Pancreatitis, Atlanta, 1992). The two most common forms of acute pancreatitis are alcoholic pancreatitis and gallstone pancreatitis. [MeSH]
A thin round or oval ring of soft-tissue attenuation surrounding an area of fat attenuation adjacent to the colon, as seen on CT. Suggest epiploic appendagitis.

label: hyperlucent hemithorax sign
definition: Increased lucency of one hemithorax on a supine radiograph of an infant; ipsilateral mediastinal border is also clearly outlined. Suggests accumulation of air anterior to the lung.

label: hypernephroma halo sign
definition: A lucent, nonfat halo partially or completely surrounds a renal mass. May suggests hypernephroma.

label: hypotensive nephrogram sign
definition: Bilateral prolonged nephrogram phase of an intravenous pyelogram, suggesting arterial hypotension.

label: hysterogram sign
definition: Persistent opacification of the uterus of an otherwise healthy female on an intravenous pyelogram. Suggests uterine leiomyoma, but may be normal.

label: ice cream cone sign
definition: Ossicles resemble ice cream cone with ball of ice cream on a transverse CT of the temporal bone. Ball represents head of malleus, and cone represents body of incus. Sign indicates ossicles are normal.

label: iceberg sign
definition: Sharp opacity extends through the diaphgram and resembles the tip of an iceberg as it diverges away from the spine on a chest or abdominal radiograph. Suggests lesion resides on both thorax and abdomen, such as a thoracoabdominal aneurysm, esophagogastric lesion, azyogs continuation of the inferior vena cava, or paraverterbral tuberculosis abcess.

label: iliopsoas-gluteus medius sign
definition: Soft-tissue prominence and outward displacement of fat pad lines both superolateral and inferomedial to the femoral head on a radiograph of the hip. Suggests transitory synovitis of the hip joint. Superolateral prominence represents gluteus medius muscle; inferomedial prominence represents iliopsoas muscle.

label: incomplete border sign of abdomen
definition: Soft-tissue abdominal mass with well-defined border on some sides and ill-defined border on others. Indicates extraperitoneal mass; incomplete border is found where mass attaches to abdominal wall.

label: incomplete border sign of lung
definition: A mass near the lung's periphery whose border is sharp everywhere but near the chest wall on a frontal radiograph. Suggests extrapleural region over an intrapulmonary lesion.

label: surgical capsule of prostate
definition: tissue plane separating transition zone from outer gland. This is an important surgical plane, but there is disagreement as to whether it is a real structure.

label: incomplete fissure sign
definition: A curvilinear line xray separating perihilar lucency and peripheral opacity, seen on frontal chest radiograph. Suggests pleural effusion in a lung with a major fissure that is incomplete medially.

label: incomplete ring sign of duodenum
definition: Cholecystographic contrast collects in an incomplete ring shape medial and posterior to the gallbladder. Suggest duodenal ulcer.

label: incomplete ring sign of vertebra
definition: Lateral and posterior portions of vertebra are not continuous at the pars interarticularis on CT. Indicates spondylolysis.

label: indefinite uterus sign
definition: Uterus appears enlarged due to similar echo pattern created by adjacent solid mass on an ultrasound.

label: indrawn pleura sign
definition: Opaque line extending from visceral pleura to peripheral intrapulmonary mass. Suggests scar resulting from inflammatory disease or atelectasis due to obstruction by mass; mass is often alveolar cell carcinoma.

label: infinity sign
definition: Thalamostriate-internal cerebral vein complex resembles an infinity symbol on a frontal cerebral angiogram. Suggests large avascular mass with opacification of ipsilateral vessels.

label: intercostal bulging lung sign
definition: Lucent lung bulges between ribs on an oblique radiograph. Typically suggests emphysema, but may also be normal, especially in an emaciated patient.

label: interface sign
definition: Sharp interface between peripheral collection of fluid and liver or spleen on a CT scan. Suggests intraperitoneal fluid over intrapleural fluid.

label: interstitial line sign
definition: An echogenic line from a mass to the endometrial echo complex. May be seen with interstitial ectopic pregnancy.

label: intrahepatic gas sign
definition: Unexplained gas in the liver visible on a radiograph, suggesting trauma.

label: intraosseous gas sign
definition: Gas is seen within the medullary cavity of a bone on a CT scan. Suggests osteomyelitis.

label: intravertebral vacuum cleft sign
definition: Linear or semilunar lucency in a collapsed vertebral body, representing accumulation of gas. Typically indicates osteonecrosis.

label: inverted U sign
definition: Dilated redundant loop of colon that forms an inverted U shape, possibly extending to the diaphragm. Suggests sigmoid volvulus.

label: inverted V sign
definition: Lateral umbilical ligaments are outlined, forming an opaque inverted V as they extend umbilicus. Suggests pneumoperitoneum.

label: ivory osteoma
definition: Localized periosteal reaction produces sclerotic cortex beneath an ulcer. Suggests tropical ulcer.

label: ivory phalanx sign
definition: Increased density of one phalanx seen on a radiograph of the foot. Suggests psoriatic arthritis.

label: ivory vertebra sign
definition: Increase in opacity of a vertebral body, with normal size, contours, and adjacent intervertebral disks. In children, suggests lymphoma; in adults, usually indicates osteoblastic metastasis, Paget disease, or lymphoma.

label: J sign
definition: The inferior glenohumeral ligament is J-shaped rather than the usual U-shape. Formed by free, humeral end of the ligament moving inferiorly after avulsion.

label: jack stone
definition: Spiked calculus of calcium oxalate dihydrate that resembles a jack toy. Often found in bladder, but may be found in kidney.

label: jailbars sign
definition: Ribs appear as homogenous, dense bars on a frontal radiograph. Suggests sclerosis due to myeloid metaplasia, sickle cell disease, or other osteosclerotic condition.

label: panniculitis
definition: General term for inflammation of adipose tissue, usually of the skin, characterized by reddened subcutaneous nodules. [MeSH]

label: jet phenomenon
definition: Rapid flow of oral contrast through a stenosed region of the esophagus with proximal dilatation, resembling the wake of a jet. Suggests esophageal web.

label: jet sign
definition: Dense stream of contrast from ureteral orifice crosses bladder obliquely to opposite wall on an intravenous pyelogram. May suggest inflammatory process or may be normal.

label: joint mice
definition: multiple ossified synovial fragments within joint space

label: juxtaphrenic peak sign
definition: Well-defined opacity pointing to the uppermost part of a dome from the medial hemidiaphram on a frontal radiograph or from the anterior hemidiaphragm on a lateral radiograph. Opacity is usually sharp, but may be rounded; multiple opacities sometimes present. Suggests upper lobe atelectasis.

label: keyboard sign
definition: Parallel striped pattern of echoes in small bowel wall on ultrasound examination resembles a keyboard. Represents valvulae conniventes of fluid-filled bowel.

label: keyhole sign of bladder
definition: Thick-walled bladder and dilated posterior urethra resemble a keyhole on an ultrasound of a male fetus or infant. Suggests obstruction due to posterior urethral valves.

label: keyhole sign of duodenum
definition: Contrast is trapped within parallel duodenal folds; sign disappears with distension by gas or peristalsis. Suggests duodenal bulb pseudolesion.

label: kidney sweat
definition: Sliver of fluid, visible as extracapsular hypoechoic rim on ultrasound. Indicates perirenal edema. May also be visible on CT or MR.

label: kinky chest tube sign
definition: Mediastinal tube appears kinked on a radiograph in a patient following median sternotomy. Suggests entrapment of a mediastinal tube in a sternal suture.

label: kissing sequestra sign
definition: Two sequestrations in opposing bones that meet across the joint on a radiograph. Suggests tuberculous arthritis.

label: parotitis
definition: inflammation of the parotid gland. [MeSH]

label: knuckle sign
definition: In chest radiography, an abrupt tapering of a large pulmonary artery caused by pulmonary embolism.

label: lace-like pattern of joint
definition: Pattern that may be seen with sarcoid arthropathy.

label: lace-like pattern of ovary
definition: Ultrasound appearance of hemorrhagic ovarian cysts.

label: lacunar skull
definition: A mesenchymal dysplasia of the membranous skull vault. May be seen in infants with Chiari II malformation.

label: lambda sign of aorta
definition: Small ascending aorta; seen in hypoplastic left heart syndrome.

label: lambda sign of chest
definition: On a Gallium-67 citrate scan, uptake in the hilar and paratracheal lymph nodes gives the appearance of a lambda. Seen in sarcoidosis.

label: lateral capsular sign
definition: Bone fragment seen lateral to the lateral tibial plateau on a frontal radiograph of the knee. Suggests Segond fracture with anterior cruciate ligament tear.

label: lateral femoral notch sign
definition: Lateral femoral notch is abnormally indented. Usually indicates a torn anterior cruciate ligament and subsequent impaction between lateral femoral notch and rim of tibial plateau.

label: laterally displaced ureter sign
definition: Ureter is dilated and laterally displaced on an intravenous pyelogram. Typically suggests ureteral duplication, even if second ureter is not visible; obstruction of second ureter causes lateral displacement and dilation of both ureters, which reside in the same sheath. May also suggest malignant neoplasm.

label: lead pipe sign
definition: Complete loss of haustral markings in diseased section of colon, which appears smooth-walled and cylindrical. Seen in patients with chronic ulcerative colitis.

label: pericarditis
definition: Inflammation of the pericardium. (Dorland, 27th ed) [MeSH]

label: leafless tree sign
definition: Terminal bronchi do not opacify on a bronchogram. Suggests alveolar cell carcinoma or bronchitis.

label: left atrial notch sign
definition: Rounded indentation in the inferior border of the left atrium on a frontal radiograph. Suggests persistent left superior vena cava.

label: lemon sign
definition: Abnormally flat or concave frontal bones give fetal skull a lemon shape on transverse sonograms. Most commonly associated with spina bifida and several other developmental abnormalities. Seen before 24 weeks gestational age.

label: leontiasis ossea
definition: Lion-like facies; a form of polyostotic fibrous dysplasia that involves skull and facial bones

label: life buoy sign
definition: Round filling defect of the gallbladder with central density, resembling a life buoy. Suggests adenomyomatosis.

label: light bulb sign
definition: High signal intensity on T2-weighted images that may be seen in pheochromocytomas.

Multiple hypointense curvilinear lines are seen within hyperintense silicone breast implant on T2-weighted MRI, resembling noodles. Indicates intracapsular rupture of implant; lines are produced by collapsed elastomeric shell.

label: little finger sign
definition: Thin epiglottic shadow resembles a little finger on a lateral radiograph. Suggests epiglottis is normal.

label: lobster claw
definition: Calyceal fornices extend into the papilla, resembling a lobster claw on an intravenous pyelogram. Suggests papillary necrosis.

label: lollipop sign of diverticula
definition: Appearance of diverticula that may been seen on hysterosalpingography in patients with adenomyosis.

label: peritonitis
definition: inflammation of the peritoneum lining the abdominal cavity as the result of infectious, autoimmune, or chemical processes. Primary peritonitis is due to infection of the peritoneal cavity via hematogenous or lymphatic spread and without intra-abdominal source. Secondary peritonitis arises from the abdominal cavity itself through rupture or abscess of intra-abdominal organs. [MeSH]

label: lollipop sign
definition: A hepatic or portal vein terminating at or just within the periphery of a liver lesion, described in hepatic epithelioid hemangioendothelioma.

label: lollipop-tree sign
definition: Intrahepatic bile ducts contain multiple cystic spaces, seen on a cholangiogram. Suggests Caroli disease or congenital hepatic fibrosis.

label: loop-to-loop colon
definition: Transverse colon extends to abdominal wall, and descending colon extends medially to fill left renal fossa, forming a loop. Suggests renal agenesis or ectopia.

label: lucent cleft sign
definition: Smooth, lucent cleft anterior to the vertebral body end-plate on an extension lateral radiograph of the cervical spine. Suggests cervical disc injury or disease; gas fills low-pressure space where disk avulses from end-plate.

label: lucent liver sign
definition: Liver is more radiolucent than soft tissue of adjacent abdominal wall on a frontal radiograph of a newborn. Typically suggests air trapped between anterior surface of liver and peritoneum.

label: Luftsichel sign
definition: Crescent- or sickle-shaped lucency adjacent to aortic arch on a frontal radiograph. Suggests upper lobe collapse, with positioning of the lower lobe between the mediastinum and the collapsed lobe.

label: lumen with a lumen sign
definition: Intramural extravasation of contrast is seen in addition to filling of bowel lumen. Suggests ischemic colitis with mucosal sloughing.
An appearance of fused kidneys.

label: lying-down adrenal gland
definition: Adrenal gland appears long and slender with ipsilateral renal agenesis.

label: Madelung deformity
definition: chondrodysplasia of distal radial epiphysis

label: magnification sign
definition: Mandible appears magnified compared to the upper jaw on a frontal radiograph. Suggests triple mandibular fracture.

label: maiden waist deformity
definition: Both ureters are narrowed and drawn medially, creating the outline of a body with a narrow waist. Suggests retroperitoneal fibrosis.

label: main en lorgnette deformity
definition: Proximal phalangeal compression and metacarpophalangeal dislocation cause telescoping of the fingers, resembling opera glasses. Suggests rheumatoid arthritis or arthritis mutilans.

label: mandibular mantle sign
definition: Thin layer of periosteal new bone on the inferior surface of the mandible on a radiograph of an infant. If seen in low-birth-weight infant, suggests nutritional rickets; if seen in infant with dyspnea or apnea, suggests lung disease of skeletal origin.

label: marble bone
definition: Dense cortical bone, characteristic of osteopetrosis.

label: MCA dot sign
definition: High-attenuation dot in the Sylvian fissure on nonconstrast transverse CT images, suggesting middle cerebral artery thromboembolism.

label: medial stripe sign
definition: Unilateral lucent stripe extending along the entire border of the mediastinum on a frontal. Suggests pneumothorax.

label: Medusa head sign
definition: Small veins radially arranged around and drain into a larger vein on an MR image of the head, typically in the juxtacortical and periventricular zones of the frontal and parietal lobes. Suggests developmental venous anomaly.

label: Medusa locks sign
definition: Pattern of intestinal gas resembles the coiled snakes of Medusa's hair on an abdominal radiograph. Produced by bolus of worms in ascariasis.

label: mega-aeroesophagus sign
definition: Massive distension of the esophagus with air seen on a radiograph of a child. Typically suggests cerebral palsy or mental retardation; may also be caused by gastroesophageal reflux or esophageal obstruction.

label: petrous apicitis
definition: infection with involvement of bone at the very apex of the petrous temporal bone.

label: melting sign
definition: Lung density whose periphery shrinks over time on frontal radiographs, with pleural base remaining intact. Suggests pulmonary infarct.

label: Mercedes Benz sign
definition: Right upper quadrant lucency in the shape of the triradiate Mercedes-Benz symbol. Suggests cholelithiasis; pattern produced by nitrogen-containing fissures within gallstone.

label: mesenteric vein sign
definition: Superior mesenteric vein is displaced on an ultrasound. If displaced anteriorly, suggests nonpancreatic retroperitoneal mass. If displaced posteriorly, suggests pancreatic mass.

label: metacarpal sign
definition: Fourth metacarpal is abnormally short; line drawn from head of fifth metacarpal to head of fourth intersects head of third. Several causes, but typically suggests Turner syndrome.

label: Mickey Mouse sign of bladder
definition: Dilated bladder and greatly distended ureters resemble the head and ears of Mickey Mouse on an intravenous pyelogram of a child. Suggests bilateral hydronephrosis.

label: midsternal stripe sign
definition: Thin, vertical lucencies in the sternum on a frontal radiograph following sternotomy. May predict sternal dehiscence.

label: migrating staple sign
definition: Staple used to suture peripheral lung parenchyma shifts over time on sequential radiographs. Suggests pneumothorax; stapled parenchyma collapses and moves toward hilum.

label: miliary pattern
definition: Innumerable small (1- to 4-mm diameter) nodules scattered widely throughout the lungs.ÿ

label: Milwaukee shoulder
definition: chronic rotator cuff tear

label: molar tooth sign of bladder
definition: Perivesicular extravasation of contrast on CT cystogram in a patient with extraperitoneal bladder rupture.

label: molar tooth sign of brain
definition: Midbrain, with elongated and perpendicular superior cerebellar peduncles, resembles a molar tooth on transverse images. Inidcates Joubert syndrome, in which peduncles fail to decussate and subsequently enlarge.

label: molar tooth sign of inner ear
definition: Outlines of incus and malleus normally resemble a molar tooth on a lateral tomograph. Head of malleus and body of incus are crown; handle of malleus is anterior root; long process of incus is posterior rooth. Irregularity suggests pathology affecting abnormal part of tooth.

label: monocle sign
definition: Circular lucency adjacent to a circular opacity on a chest radiograph. Lucency is a bronchus; indicates opacity is a pulmonary artery and not a calcified lymph node.

label: moon crescent sign
definition: Curvilinear sonolucency between the liver and right perirenal fat on a transverse ultrasound. Suggests juxtahepatic effusion.

label: moth-eaten calyx
definition: Calyx has ragged edges, suggesting renal tuberculosis.

A pattern of bone loss observed on radiographs, indicating a more aggressive process than in geographic bone destruction but perhaps less aggressive than in permeative bone destruction. In the motheaten pattern, the lesional margins are less well defined and the transitional zone from normal to abnormal bone is longer than in the geographic pattern. Typically seen with malignant bone tumours and osteomyelitis.

label: moulage sign
definition: Bowel is dilated with effaced folds, resembling a smooth tube filled with wax. Suggests celiac sprue.

label: Mount Fuji sign
definition: Frontal lobes are compressed by air, forming a peak; they are also separated at the apex. Indicates tension pneumocephalus.

label: mucosal stripe sign
definition: Lucent linear stripe parallel to the esophageal wall. Represents intramural esophageal dissection; line represents dissected mucosa and separates true lumen from false.

label: mulberry stone
definition: Calcium oxalate dihydrate calculus with less-developed spikes than a jack toy, resembling a mulberry.

label: pharyngitis
definition: Inflammation of the throat. [MeSH]

label: multiple concentric ring sign
definition: Central echo with concentric rings of sonolucency and sonodensity on an ultrasound. Suggests intussusception.

label: musculoskeletal crescent sign
definition: Subchondral lucent line, usually in proximal femoral or humeral head, visible on a radiograph. Indicates avascular necrosis. More readily visible when traction is applied.

label: Naclerio V sign
definition: V-shaped radiolucency seen in the lower left mediastinum in frontal x-ray. One limb outlines the mediastinal border; the other divides the parietal pleura from left hemidiaphragm. Seen in pneumomediastinum, typically secondary to esophageal rupture.

label: naked facet sign
definition: Articulating facets between two adjacent vertebrae appear naked on CT. Anterior subluxation of the superior vertebra causes their displacement, with only one set visible in a given transverse image.

label: nasopharyngeal soft-tissue sign
definition: Widening of the soft-tissue of the posterior nasopharyngeal wall on a lateral radiograph of the skull. Originally ascribe to basal skull fracture, but may also represent prevertebral abscess, cervical spine tumor, or normal variation in children.

label: navicular fat stripe sign
definition: Displacement or absence of normal lucency seen between radial collateral ligament next to the scaphoid and the synovial tendon sheaths of the abductor pollicis longus and extensor pollicis brevis. Suggests fracture of scaphoid, radial styloid process, or first metacarpal.

label: negative pyelogram
definition: Dilated collecting system is filled with unopacified urine, producing reverse image of normal pyelogram. Suggests hydronephrosis.

label: Neuhaser sign
definition: Normal nasopharyngeal lymphoid tissue is absent on a lateral radiograph. Suggests congenital agammaglobulinemia.

label: nipple sign
definition: Appearance of hypertrophic pyloric stenosis that may be seen on ultrasound.

label: notched ureter sign
definition: Ureter appears sharply scalloped on an intravenous pyelogram, caused by external compression. May suggest renal artery stenosis, in which collateral arteries develop around the ureter; enlarged adjacent lymph nodes; venous obstruction, leading to increased flow through collateral vessels.

label: pseudocapsule of prostate
synonyms: prostatic capsule|capsule of prostate|prostate pseudocapsule|prostatic pseudocapsule
definition: thin fibrous tissue surrounding prostate, posterolaterally. The capsule is not present anteriorly and at the apex. [PI-RADS]: Histologically, there is no distinct capsule that surrounds the prostate, however historically the “capsule” has been defined as an outer band of the prostatic fibromuscular stroma blending with endopelvic fascia and may be visible on imaging as a distinct thin layer of tissue surrounding or partially surrounding the peripheral zone. [Radiopaedia]: The prostate gland lacks a true capsule and the so-called "prostate capsule" is a pseudocapsule formed from fibromuscular tissue surrounding three distinct layers of fascia; the anterior, lateral, and posterior fasciae.

label: pleuritis
definition: inflammation of pleura, the lining of the lung. When PARIETAL pleura is involved, there is pleuritic chest pain. [MeSH]

label: nubbin sign
definition: Small nubbin of tissue with faintly visible collecting system inferior to a healthy upper kidney pole on an intravenous pyelogram. Suggests renal duplication with atrophy of lower pole due to reflux, infection, obstruction, or congenital hypoplasia.

label: nutmeg liver
definition: Pattern of liver enhancement seen with passive congestion.

label: obscured outer edge sign
definition: Outer edge of a chest tube overlying the pleura is not visible on a frontal radiograph. Suggests tube, which is of soft-tissue density, resides in chest wall rather than the pleural space.

label: obturator sign
definition: Unilaterally enlarged soft-tissue density on the inner pelvic wall, representing the obturator internus muscle, with medial displacement of the fat pad on a frontal radiograph. Suggests pelvic trauma and hemorrhage or infectious arthritis of the hip joint.

label: okra sign
definition: Cross section of pylorus resembles cross section of okra within duodenal bulb; pattern produced by contrast trapped between mucosal folds.

label: omega sign
definition: Crescent-shaped filling defect of gallbladder with central pit, resembling the Greek letter Omega. Suggests adenomyomatosis.

label: one-bone-two-bone sign
definition: Fetal long bone can be identified by number of bones visible on a cross-sectional ultrasound. One bone indicates appendage is arm (humerus) or thigh (femur). Two bones indicates appendage is forearm (radius and ulna) or leg (tibia and fibula).

label: one-two-three sign
